patterns_discovered.description: .chart-wrap uses max-width:100% to prevent exceeding parent width, overflow-x:auto adds scrollbar only if content overflows

patterns_discovered.pattern: Flexbox with min-width:0 for proper shrinking
patterns_discovered.description: .chart uses display:flex with min-width:0, preventing default min-content overflow behavior
Labels column has fixed 190px width (flex-shrink:0), bars area uses flex:1 for flexible width allocation
All absolute positioning within .bars-area uses percentage values (left%, width%) instead of fixed pixels
Global box-sizing:border-box ensures padding is included in width calculations throughout layout

gotchas_discovered.description: Without min-width:0 on .bars-area and .chart, flexbox defaults to min-content width, causing overflow even with max-width:100%
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Explicitly set min-width:0 on all flex children needing to shrink below content size

gotchas_discovered.gotcha: Body padding reduces available viewport width
gotchas_discovered.description: At 1280px viewport, 32px left + 32px right padding = 64px total, leaving only 1216px for content
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Account for body padding when calculating responsive breakpoints and component max-widths

gotchas_discovered.gotcha: overflow-x:auto visible only when content exceeds max-width
gotchas_discovered.description: Scrollbar appears conditionally based on content width vs max-width constraint
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Test with varying data sizes to ensure scrollbar behavior is correct

gotchas_discovered.gotcha: Summary table max-width must be constrained separately
gotchas_discovered.description: Summary table needs its own max-width:640px to prevent exceeding viewport width independently of chart constraints
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Apply consistent max-width constraints to all major layout blocks

recommendations.recommendation: Test responsive layout at multiple viewport widths (320px, 768px, 1024px, 1280px, 1920px) to ensure consistent behavior across breakpoints
Document responsive breakpoints and layout thresholds in CSS comments for future maintenance
Use test HTML file (.cards/test-gantt-responsive.html) as regression test baseline for future CSS changes
Test scrollbar appearance behavior across browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari) to ensure consistent overflow handling
Consider testing with browser zoom levels (75%, 100%, 125%, 150%) to verify layout remains stable
